title: Particles of Matter Are Continuously Moving
subject: Chemistry
objective: An agarbatti's smell reaches the next room without a fan. The particles of matter never stop moving, and they move faster when it is hotter.

fill.q: The intermixing of particles on their own is called ____.

tf.q: Diffusion is faster in hot water than in cold water.
The smell of incense spreads because of diffusion.
tf.explain: Gas particles move and mix with air.

tf.q: Particles stop moving when matter is at rest.

ar.a: Diffusion is faster in hot water.
ar.r: Particles move faster at higher temperature.
Particles in solids are tightly packed.
ar.explain: A is false; R is true and is why diffusion is slowest in solids.

mcq.q: The smell of food reaching you from the kitchen is due to:

short.q: What is diffusion? Give two examples.
short.solution: Intermixing of particles of different substances on their own. Examples: smell of perfume spreading; ink spreading in water.

short.q: Why is diffusion faster in gases and at higher temperature?
short.solution: Gas particles are far apart and move freely; heat increases their kinetic energy, so they move and mix faster.
